purpose: Archival snapshot of the BinSight ML v1 branch. Every run below is preserved, including the ones that failed — they are the engineering history and the reason the next branch is designed the way it is.

trashnet_tensorflow_baseline.why_not_selected: Classifies the whole frame; cannot localise, cannot handle multiple items, cannot say 'nothing here'. In-distribution accuracy did not survive uncontrolled camera scenes.

yolo26n_run_001.dataset: partial TACO, 509 images / 1290 boxes (Flickr HTTP 429 losses)

yolo26n_run_002_full_taco_640.interruption_reason: SIGKILL from macOS memory pressure, three times (during epochs 13, 24 and 25). No Python traceback, no MPS diagnostic and no OOM message in any log — the process simply stopped mid-batch. An iOS Simulator and xcodebuild workload was active on the same ~8.6 GB machine. Resumed twice from last.pt, then paused by decision for analysis.
yolo26n_run_002_full_taco_640.dataset: recovered TACO, 1082 images / 2671 boxes (86.7% of official records)

yolo26n_final_taco_context_plus_crops_76.interruption_reason: SIGKILL at 99% of epoch 15 (batch 447/451), same signature: no traceback, no OOM message. Fourth such kill in the project. Not resumed — training was stopped by decision because the 768 configuration is not reliably completable on this host.
yolo26n_final_taco_context_plus_crops_76.dataset: 748 scenes + 1056 object-centric train-only crops (median target 29x larger)
yolo26n_final_taco_context_plus_crops_76.test_metrics_note: never evaluated on test — an incomplete run is not a result

retention_policy: Nothing is deleted. Failed and incomplete runs are kept with their weights, results.csv, args.yaml and plots, because the reason a run failed is part of the record.
